Exercise 8. a) The Minister has not ruled out a delay. b) The Minister said he would not go into details.
c) The Minister has neither confirmed nor denied the news. d) If the plan isn't too much, ask yourself. expensive, the minister replied that each plan has a cost.
a) Mona al-Šarīf, professor of water management, interviewed for longer droughts.

Questions: 1 open (assessment); 2 oriented ('not enough?') 3 In-depth study ('what do you mean ...?') 4 of implicit comparison (objection on the cost for small farmers); 5 of comparison ('what is the answer to those who say...?) 6 Closed (is it optimistic?) 7 Open, final. ⁧بصراحة⁩ (answer 1) announces a net judgment (the situation is worrying) ⁧يعني⁩ (answer 6) takes time before a nuanced response (the optimist with caution) is given. Dams: useful but do not create water, they store it; desalination: part of the solution for coastal cities, but consumes a lot of energy and leaves saline residues; irrigation: agriculture consumes around80% of water, much is lost by old methods; The drop would save hugely, with the support of the state. The demand oriented is the 2: the expert does not accept the premise (the dams do not create water).

b) The project will see the light, the work has advanced considerably ( ⁧قال⁩ , ⁧مؤكدا⁩ ); the project It will cut down on time and create thousands of places ( ⁧دافع⁩ , ⁧معتبرا⁩ ); the two objectives are not at odds and there is a budget for maintenance ( ⁧أجاب⁩ ). Refusal or avoidance: the date of entry into service ( ⁧تجنب الإجابة⁩ , ⁧اكتفى بالقول⁩ ); any cost ( ⁧رفض الكشف⁩ ); the value of the maintenance balance ( ⁧دون أن يحدد⁩ ); the nature of the circumstances ( ⁧دون أن يوضح⁩ ). Neither confirmed nor denied: the increase in 40% costs ( ⁧لم يؤكده ولم ينفه⁩ ). Not excluded: a new delay ( ⁧لم يستبعد⁩ ). Techniques: delay (do not anticipate events) generalize (do any major project face challenges) refuse (figures, referral to the Court of Auditors). The journalist adds: the originally planned date, the local newspaper article on costs, observers and the opposition's request.
